title: Paragon armor
wikitext: {{TOCright}} A full set of [[Paragon]] armor consists of a crest, raiment, armguards, leggings and sandals. ==Armor bonuses== [[Basic armor|Basic]] Paragon armor provides up to a maximum of 80 [[Armor rating|armor]] and 10 extra [[energy]].
